# The Rust Compilation Pipeline
Understanding how `rustc` compiles code:
1. Parsing & Macro Expansion -> AST
2. HIR (High-level Intermediate Representation) -> Type checking
3. MIR (Mid-level Intermediate Representation) -> Borrow checker & optimizations
4. LLVM IR -> Native machine code generation
